tldr: Venus in the 1st house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward your identity and body
body: Venus in the 1st house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward your identity and body. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 1st house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through identity, body, presence, and first response to life. This makes how you enter the room, claim space, and let the world meet you a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through selfhood and embodiment.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in selfhood and embodiment.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
